>_ Episode 4 · Jul 30, 2026 · 55m

Are LLMs "Alien" Digital Species? Built? Grown? Or What? Debunking the AI Hype

Play Episode 4 on YouTube
Watch on YouTube SpotifyApple Podcasts

In this episode of Philosophy Programs and Prompts, Casey Hart (@OntologyExplained) and Carl Brown(@InternetOfBugs) tackle the wild narratives surrounding artificial intelligence. Are Large Language Models really a "new digital species" or "alien intelligences" that are grown rather than built?

Casey and Carl break down the economic speculation driving the AI space, address the hype from figures like Mustafa Suleiman and Nate Soares, and strip away the sensational metaphors. Carl explains how neural networks actually operate—comparing LLMs to compressed search indexes rather than biological entities—while Casey explores the philosophical implications around language, meaning, and the problem of other minds.
